item.title: Tokyo Sushi Making Class Guide: Learn from a Trained Itamae
item.description: Sushi looks deceptively simple — a slice of fish on a mound of rice — but every element conceals years of craft. In a Tokyo sushi-making class, a trained itamae (sushi chef) reveals those secrets: how to season and handle the rice, how to wield a Japanese knife, and how to shape nigiri and roll maki with the right pressure and form. You leave not only having eaten beautiful sushi you made yourself, but with knife and rice fundamentals that quietly change how you eat — and make — sushi for the rest of your life.
